## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL regime. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive; confirmation: broad sector positivity but narrow leadership (Top 5 = 5/5 Energy), and major divergence across large caps (MSFT, AMZN, BA, LLY show 1W vs 1M mismatches) — watch for trend breaks.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +8.78%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +4.61% | 1M: +9.70%) ABOVE TREND. Technology has selective leadership: LRCX (1W: +6.75% | 1M: +3.55%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +2.68%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +6.28% | 1M: +17.26%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Consumer Staples weak: MNST (1W: -49.62% | 1M: -54.45%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary/Materials show strain with AMZN (1W: -4.31% | 1M: +5.11%) CORRECTION, FCX (1W: -4.50% | 1M: +13.54%) CORRECTION, and HD (1W: -4.71% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +14.54% | 1M: +14.23%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +13.67% | 1M: +19.09%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +7.80% | 1M: +12.35%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +8.78%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Energy), caution on concentration.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: AMZN (1W: -4.31% | 1M: +5.11%) CORRECTION, FCX (1W: -4.50% | 1M: +13.54%) CORRECTION, RCL (1W: -4.69% | 1M: +3.76%) CORRECTION, HON (1W: -4.69% | 1M: +3.68%) CORRECTION, HD (1W: -4.71% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select consumer names and isolated industrials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +14.54% | 1M: +14.23%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +13.67% | 1M: +19.09%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +6.75% | 1M: +3.55%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +2.68%) ABOVE TREND — note major divergence in mega-caps (MSFT, AMZN, BA, LLY) implying tactical moves, not broad conviction.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but constructive: LRCX (1W: +6.75% | 1M: +3.55%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +2.68%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +6.28% | 1M: +17.26%) ABOVE TREND while AAPL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -8.12%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -2.41%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -0.38% | 1M: -11.24%) BELOW TREND — sector showing internal rotation.

8. Financials Outlook?
Constructive: JPM (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +5.74%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +3.22%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +0.64% | 1M: -0.09%) RECOVERY — Financials part of the leadership mix supporting a Value/Cyclical tilt.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Mixed with headline dispersion: JNJ (1W: +0.43% | 1M: +4.15%) ABOVE TREND and PFE (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +8.43%) ABOVE TREND countered by UNH (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -5.11%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: -0.33% | 1M: +1.08%) CORRECTION — watch news-driven swings (UNH negative sentiment).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Energy exposure and selective Financials given narrow but powerful Energy leadership; reduce exposure to lagging Consumer Staples/Discretionary and select mega-cap Tech that are BELOW TREND. Style: Value/Cyclical tilt, but limit size given concentration risk and major divergence signals.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +8.78%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +6.28% | 1M: +17.26%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: AAPL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -8.12%) BELOW TREND, UNH (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -5.11%) BELOW TREND, MNST (1W: -49.62% | 1M: -54.45%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +9.05% | 1M: +10.77%) showing clear strength; Financials (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +3.03%) constructive. BEARISH: Consumer Staples (1W: -3.32% | 1M: -3.41%) and Consumer Discretionary (1W: -1.34% | 1M: +1.11%) remain vulnerable.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch Energy continuation triggers: MPC/PSX sustainment above their 1W pivot to confirm run; NVDA (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +8.56%) needs to hold recent 1M pivot to confirm ABOVE TREND resilience; AAPL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -8.12%) must reclaim its 1M trend to exit BELOW TREND; JPM (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +5.74%) breakout above recent 1M highs would signal financials follow-through.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
JNJ (+75): J&J FDA clearance headline; JNJ (1W: +0.43% | 1M: +4.15%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. AMD (+50): Microsoft-related catalyst; AMD (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +2.68%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. HON (+60): strong orders headline; HON (1W: -4.69% | 1M: +3.68%) CORRECTION — bullish news but price in short-term pullback, monitor for follow-through.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
UNH (-90): legal/management headline; UNH (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -5.11%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed and material. META (-50): trial headline; META (1W: -0.38% | 1M: -11.24%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. BA (-45): aviation headlines; BA (1W: -1.17% | 1M: +8.09%) CORRECTION — negative news while 1M remains positive, watch for momentum shift.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime with a Value/Cyclical tilt; Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive but leadership is narrow (Energy). MPC, CVX, LRCX showing relative strength (ABOVE TREND). Key risk: major divergence among large caps and negative UNH headlines — watch for trend breaks and news-driven rotation.
